app.name: Luqta
app.tagline: Wishlist & product comparison — no external calls

home.emptyBody: Share a product link into Luqta from any app, or paste text here.

share.title: New catch
share.localOnly: No third-party AI/services. We only read the product link you share.
share.corsHint: The store blocked reading the page in the browser (CORS). Use the Luqta extension on the product tab, or paste the title and price with the link.
share.pasteHint: Paste a product URL or a short description
share.missingShare: Nothing shared yet. Paste a URL or text.

compare.title: Side-by-side
compare.needTwo: Pick at least two products to compare

settings.title: Settings
settings.privacyBody: Everything runs on your device. No backend, no account — data stays in IndexedDB.
settings.offlineBody: Luqta does not call AI models or third-party APIs. It may open the product page you shared to read title and price locally. Your data stays in IndexedDB.
settings.installHint: Install Luqta as a PWA so it appears in your phone’s share sheet.

errors.extractFailed: Extraction failed. Check the text and try again.
